title: 少しだけ
restoration: 原画の切り出し・規格内の紙色補正（拡大・反転なし）

tasks.script: LEFT ①: Hajime meets friendly silver-haired Naru in black-and-WHITE streetwear jacket and asks 「少しだけ教えて。」 Naru happily opens one notebook. RIGHT ②: instant absurd expansion to an ENTIRE UNIVERSITY lecture theatre and campus of dessert science, Naru same silver hair and black/white jacket but with a professor's academic cap, pointing to giant cake/vanilla diagrams on the blackboard. Banner 「なる大学」. Hajime is now enrolled at a student desk surrounded by endless notebooks, his black baseball cap clearly visible. Naru warmly asks 「ノート、持った？」 Hajime astonished says 「入学してる。」 No fees or coercion: exaggerated generous teaching obsession, not evil arrogant professor.
